company.name: Rank
company.shortDescription: Rank, formerly Moni, is a money app for communities built to make prosperity common; Powered by Rank Microfinance Bank & Rank Capital
company.description: Rank (formerly Moni or Moni Africa) is a fintech company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. It operates a community-powered money application designed to help individuals and small businesses save, borrow, spend, and manage money. The company is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and operates through two regulated entities: Rank Microfinance Bank and Rank Capital Limited.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,755,592 to $2,000,000, a 0.73x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 87 (+4 over 90 days) and market heat at 91 (+15).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
